obs = observe()
cands = grasp_candidates("yellow_pen")

# Choose a candidate near one end of the pen along its long axis
pen_center = obs["objects"]["yellow_pen"]["center"]
cand = max(
    cands,
    key=lambda c: (c["x"] - pen_center[0]) ** 2 + (c["y"] - pen_center[1]) ** 2,
)

res = grasp(cand)
if res.get("holding_something", False):
    holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
    hx, hy, _ = holder["center"]
    rim_h = holder.get("rim_height", 0.08)

    # Carry safely above the holder rim
    carry_to(hx, hy, height=rim_h + 0.12)

    # Lower slightly above the rim opening and release so it drops/stands upright
    move_by(dz=-0.04)
    open_gripper()
    retreat(dz=0.15)
    go_home()
    check("yellow_pen", "magenta_holder")
